helpCenter.howDoIPlaceAn: How do I place an order?
helpCenter.browseTheStoreAddItems: Browse the store, add items to your cart and go to checkout. You need to sign in to place an order.
helpCenter.yesFreeOfChargeAny: Yes, free of charge, any time before the order ships. Open My Orders and choose Cancel. If you have already paid, the full amount is refunded automatically.
helpCenter.howDoITrackMy: How do I track my order?
helpCenter.openMyOrdersInYour: Open My Orders in your account to see the status of each order. Once an order ships, the courier name and tracking number are shown there.
helpCenter.whatIfIReceiveA: What if I receive a damaged or wrong item?
helpCenter.raiseAReturnFromMy: Raise a return from My Orders within the 7-day return period and choose the matching reason, or email support@cauverystore.in with photos. Returns for damaged, defective or wrong items are free.
helpCenter.deliveryIsFreeOnOrders: Delivery is free on orders of ₹500 or more. Orders below ₹500 have a flat ₹40 delivery charge.
helpCenter.sellersNormallyDispatchWithin1: Sellers normally dispatch within 1-2 business days. After that, delivery usually takes 2-4 business days within the seller's own state and 4-7 business days to the rest of India. Remote areas may take longer.
helpCenter.noWeDeliverToAddresses: No. We deliver to addresses in India only.
helpCenter.canIChangeMyDelivery: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
helpCenter.youCanUpdateTheAddress: You can update the address before the order is shipped. Once shipped, changes are not possible.
helpCenter.mostItemsCanBeReturned: Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery. If a product has a different return period, it is shown on the product page.
helpCenter.howDoIInitiateA: How do I initiate a return?
helpCenter.goToYourOrdersPage: Go to your Orders page, select the item, and click 'Return'. Follow the instructions to generate a return request.
helpCenter.whenWillIGetMy: When will I get my refund?
helpCenter.refundsAreProcessedWithin5: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the returned item is received and verified.
helpCenter.areThereAnyItemsThat: Are there any items that cannot be returned?
helpCenter.yesInnerwearSwimwearPerishableGood: Yes. Innerwear, swimwear, perishable goods, clearance items, customised or made-to-order items, and products marked "No Returns" cannot be returned. You can still report them if they arrive damaged, defective or wrong.
helpCenter.howDoICreateAn: How do I create an account?
helpCenter.clickOnLoginAndThen: Click on 'Login' and then 'Register'. Fill in your details to create your Cauvery Store account in seconds.
helpCenter.iForgotMyPasswordWhat: I forgot my password. What should I do?
helpCenter.onTheLoginPageClick: On the login page, click 'Forgot Password' and follow the instructions to reset it via email.
helpCenter.howDoIUpdateMy: How do I update my profile?
helpCenter.logInAndVisitThe: Log in and visit the Profile section. You can edit your name, email, phone number, and saved addresses.
helpCenter.yesPleaseContactOurSupport: Yes, please contact our support team at support@cauverystore.in to request account deletion.
helpCenter.upiCreditAndDebitCards: UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking and wallets, all through Razorpay.
helpCenter.absolutelyAllPaymentsAreProcessed: Absolutely. All payments are processed through Razorpay with bank-grade encryption. We do not store your payment details.
helpCenter.whatShouldIDoIf: What should I do if my payment fails?
helpCenter.firstCheckIfTheAmount: First, check if the amount was deducted. If yes, it will be refunded automatically within 5-7 days. Contact support if it does not.
helpCenter.doYouOfferCashOn: Do you offer cash on delivery?
helpCenter.notAtPresentAllOrders: Not at present. All orders are paid online through Razorpay when you place them.
helpCenter.findAnswersToCommonQuestions: Find answers to common questions or reach out to our support team.
helpCenter.getAnswersToFrequentlyAsked: Get answers to frequently asked questions about orders, shipping, returns, account, and payments at Cauvery Store.
helpCenter.noFaqsAvailableAtThe: No FAQs available at the moment.
helpCenter.ourSupportTeamIsAvailable: Our support team is available Mon-Sat, 9 AM - 6 PM.

policies.weCollectInformationYouProvide: We collect information you provide when creating an account, placing an order, or contacting support. This includes your name, email address, phone number and delivery address. We also automatically collect certain technical information such as IP address, browser type, and device information to improve our services.
policies.onlinePaymentsAreHandledBy: Online payments are handled by Razorpay, our payment partner. You enter your card, UPI or bank details on Razorpay's secure payment window, not on our pages
policies.weDoNotReceiveOr: We do not receive or store your full card number, CVV, UPI PIN or net banking password
policies.razorpayTellsUsWhetherThe: Razorpay tells us whether the payment succeeded, the amount, the payment method used and a payment reference number. We keep these with your order so we can confirm it, issue invoices and process refunds
policies.razorpayHandlesYourPaymentDetails: Razorpay handles your payment details under its own privacy policy, published at razorpay.com/privacy
policies.processAndFulfillYourOrders: Process and fulfill your orders, including sending order confirmations and updates
policies.provideCustomerSupportAndRespond: Provide customer support and respond to your inquiries
policies.sendPersonalisedProductRecommendat: Send personalised product recommendations and promotional offers (with your consent)
policies.improveOurWebsiteProductsAnd: Improve our website, products, and services based on usage patterns
policies.preventFraudAndEnsureThe: Prevent fraud and ensure the security of our platform
policies.weDoNotSellYour: We do not sell your personal information. We share only what is needed with the seller who fulfils your order (your name, delivery address and phone number), with Razorpay to process payments and refunds, and with delivery partners to deliver your order. We may also disclose information where the law requires it.
policies.weImplementIndustryStandardSecurit: We implement industry-standard security measures including SSL encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits. Your card and bank details are processed directly by Razorpay and are never stored on our servers.
policies.accessUpdateOrDeleteYour: Access, update, or delete your personal information at any time
policies.requestACopyOfThe: Request a copy of the data we hold about you
policies.fileAComplaintWithThe: File a complaint with the relevant data protection authority
policies.forPrivacyRelatedQueriesPlease: For privacy-related queries, please email us at support@cauverystore.in. We will respond within 48 hours.
policies.byAccessingOrUsingCauvery: By accessing or using Cauvery Store, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of the terms, you may not use our services.
policies.youMustBeAtLeast: You must be at least 18 years of age to use our services. By using Cauvery Store, you represent that you meet this requirement. If you are under 18, you may use the platform only under the supervision of a parent or guardian.
policies.youAreResponsibleForMaintaining: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials
policies.youMustProvideAccurateCurrent: You must provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration
policies.youAreResponsibleForAll: You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account
policies.notifyUsImmediatelyOfAny: Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use of your account
policies.cauveryStoreIsAnOnline: Cauvery Store is an online marketplace. Products are listed and sold by third-party sellers, and the contract of sale for a product is between you and that seller. Cauvery Store runs the website, takes payment on the seller's behalf, and supports you with delivery, returns and refunds as set out in these terms and our policies.
policies.allPricesAreInIndian: All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR). The price, GST and delivery charge are shown at checkout before you pay
policies.allOrdersAreSubjectTo: All orders are subject to availability and acceptance
policies.weOrTheSellerMay: We or the seller may cancel an order because of a pricing error, the item being out of stock, or suspected fraud. If you have already paid, the full amount is refunded
policies.onlinePaymentsAreProcessedBy: Online payments are processed by Razorpay Software Private Limited (Razorpay), a payment gateway. By paying online you also agree to Razorpay's terms of use, published at razorpay.com/terms
policies.youCanPayUsingThe: You can pay using the methods shown at checkout, which may include UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking and wallets
policies.youMustUseAPayment: You must use a payment method that belongs to you or that you are authorised to use, and the details you give must be accurate
policies.yourCardUpiAndBank: Your card, UPI and bank details are entered on Razorpay's secure payment window. Cauvery Store does not receive or store them
policies.anOrderPaidOnlineIs: An order paid online is confirmed only when Razorpay tells us the payment has succeeded. You will see a confirmation on screen and under My Orders
policies.yourBankOrCardIssuer: Your bank or card issuer may apply its own charges or limits. These are between you and them
policies.ifAPaymentFailsNo: If a payment fails, no order is placed and you can try again or choose another method
policies.ifMoneyLeavesYourAccount: If money leaves your account but the order is not confirmed, the amount is usually returned to the same account automatically by your bank within 5-7 business days
policies.ifYouAreChargedTwice: If you are charged twice for the same order, email support@cauverystore.in with your order number and the payment reference. We will refund the extra amount to the original payment method
policies.weAreNotResponsibleFor: We are not responsible for delays caused by your bank or the payment network once a refund has been sent
policies.youCanCancelAnOrder: You can cancel an order free of charge before it ships, and return most items within 7 days of delivery. Refunds are sent through Razorpay to the original payment method, normally within 5-7 business days. The full rules are in our Returns, Cancellations & Refunds policy, which forms part of these terms.
policies.readTheReturnsCancellationsRefunds: Read the Returns, Cancellations & Refunds policy
policies.deliveryAreasChargesAndTimeframes: Delivery areas, charges and timeframes are set out in our Shipping Policy, which forms part of these terms.
policies.doNotUseTheSite: Do not use the site for any unlawful or fraudulent purpose, or use a payment method without the owner's permission
policies.doNotAttemptToInterfere: Do not attempt to interfere with the site, its security or other customers' accounts
policies.weMaySuspendAnAccount: We may suspend an account or cancel orders where we reasonably suspect fraud or misuse
policies.allContentOnCauveryStore: All content on Cauvery Store — including text, graphics, logos, images, and software — is the property of Cauvery Store or its licensors and is protected by Indian copyright and intellectual property laws.
policies.cauveryStoreShallNotBe: Cauvery Store shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform. Our total liability is limited to the amount paid by you for the product or service in question.
policies.ifSomethingHasGoneWrong: If something has gone wrong with an order or a payment, email support@cauverystore.in with your order number. Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Nothing in these terms limits the rights you have under Indian consumer law.
policies.theseTermsAreGovernedBy: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
policies.cauveryStoreIsAMarketplace: Cauvery Store is a marketplace. Each order is packed by the seller and sent through one of several courier and postal partners
policies.theCourierForYourOrder: The courier for your order is chosen according to your pincode and the size of the parcel. You cannot choose the courier, and different parcels in one order may come by different couriers
policies.weDeliverToAddressesIn: We deliver to addresses in India only. We do not deliver outside India
policies.whetherAProductCanBe: Whether a product can be delivered to your pincode depends on the seller and on which of our couriers serve your area. If an order cannot be delivered to your address, we tell you and refund anything you have paid
policies.freeDeliveryOnOrdersOf: Free delivery on orders of Rs. 500 or more
policies.aFlatRs40Delivery: A flat Rs. 40 delivery charge applies to orders below Rs. 500
policies.theDeliveryChargeIsShown: The delivery charge is shown in your cart and at checkout before you pay. There are no other delivery fees
policies.deliveryTimeHasTwoParts: Delivery time has two parts: the time the seller takes to pack and hand over your order, and the time the courier takes to bring it to you.
policies.dispatchSellersNormallyHandYour: Dispatch: sellers normally hand your order to the courier within 1-2 business days of the order being confirmed
policies.withinTheSellerSOwn: Within the seller's own state: usually 2-4 business days after dispatch
policies.neighbouringStatesUsually35: Neighbouring states: usually 3-5 business days after dispatch
policies.restOfIndiaUsually4: Rest of India: usually 4-7 business days after dispatch
policies.remoteAreasTheNorthEast: Remote areas, the North-East, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh and the islands: usually 7-10 business days after dispatch
policies.theseAreEstimatesNotGuaranteed: These are estimates, not guaranteed dates. Actual times differ from one courier to another. Where a product page or checkout shows a different estimate for your order, that estimate applies
policies.businessDaysAreMondayTo: Business days are Monday to Saturday and do not include Sundays or public holidays
policies.deliveryCanTakeLongerDuring: Delivery can take longer during festivals and sales, in bad weather, during strikes or transport disruptions, or where the courier cannot reach your area
policies.ifYourOrderIsRunning: If your order is running late, we do not cancel it automatically. See "Late or Missing Orders" below for what you can do
policies.ordersFromMoreThanOne: Orders From More Than One Seller
policies.ifYourOrderHasProducts: If your order has products from different sellers, they may arrive in separate parcels on different days. You pay the delivery charge once for the order, not once per parcel.
policies.youCanFollowEveryStage: You can follow every stage of your order, from confirmed to packed, shipped and delivered, under My Orders
policies.onceYourOrderShipsThe: Once your order ships, the name of the courier and the tracking number are shown on the order page, so you can also track it on that courier’s own website
policies.weEmailYouWhenYour: We email you when your order is confirmed and when its status changes
policies.courierTrackingCanTakeUp: Courier tracking can take up to 24 hours to show movement after an order is marked as shipped
policies.youCanCancelAnOrder18w: You can cancel an order free of charge from My Orders at any time before it ships
policies.toCorrectADeliveryAddress: To correct a delivery address or phone number, email support@cauverystore.in with your order number as soon as possible. We can only make changes before the order is handed to the courier
policies.pleaseMakeSureSomeoneIs: Please make sure someone is available at the delivery address to receive the parcel and that your phone is reachable. The courier may call before delivery
policies.checkTheParcelBeforeAccepting: Check the parcel before accepting it. If the outer packaging is open, torn or looks tampered with, you may refuse it and tell us
policies.ifTheItemInsideIs: If the item inside is damaged, defective or not what you ordered, raise a return from My Orders within the return period. The return is free
policies.theRiskInTheGoods: The risk in the goods passes to you once the parcel has been delivered to your address
policies.theCourierTriesToDeliver: The courier tries to deliver more than once. The number of attempts depends on the courier, and is usually two or three
policies.ifDeliveryFailsBecauseThe: If delivery fails because the address is wrong or incomplete, nobody is available, or the parcel is refused, it is returned to the seller and the order is cancelled
policies.forAnOrderYouHave: For an order you have paid for, we refund the price of the items to your original payment method once the parcel is back with the seller. The delivery charge, if you paid one, is not refunded in this case
policies.ifDeliveryFailsForA: If delivery fails for a reason that is not yours, such as the courier being unable to serve your area, you receive a full refund including any delivery charge
policies.ifYourOrderHasNot: If your order has not arrived 3 business days after the latest estimated date, email support@cauverystore.in with your order number. We will trace it with the seller and the courier
policies.ifAParcelIsConfirmed: If a parcel is confirmed lost in transit, you can choose a replacement, where the seller has stock, or a full refund
policies.ifYourOrderIsMarked: If your order is marked as delivered but you have not received it, tell us within 7 days of the delivery date so that we can investigate with the courier
policies.forAnyDeliveryQuestionEmail: For any delivery question, email support@cauverystore.in with your order number. Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM.
policies.understandHowWeHandleYour: Understand how we handle your data, your rights, and our commitments to you.
policies.ifYouHaveAnyQuestions: If you have any questions about our policies, please contact us at
